release_notes: Build 99 prevents duplicate Quiz History path repair from crossing between clearly different quiz families.
A Space History row can no longer be automatically linked to a General Knowledge project just because both use the same episode number or copied project metadata contains Space text.
Folder-family identity is checked before legacy trailing episode scoring can strengthen a candidate.

The guard covers the stable quiz families including Science, History, Geography, Space, Nature & Animals, Technology, Arts & Literature, Music, Film, Sports, Entertainment, Mathematics and General Knowledge.
Logos and Icons are intentionally treated as the same quiz family so legacy Icons project folders can still match Logos Quiz History safely.
The final apply step repeats the same family and episode safety checks immediately before any database path is changed.
Duplicate-path repair remains database-only and does not move, copy, rename, overwrite or delete C: or Z: files.
Build 98 partial one-to-one repair, faster archive reporting, live C: to Z: progress, verified archive reuse and no-overwrite protections remain in place.
Regression tests cover the exact Space #003 versus General Knowledge #003 failure, a valid Space #003 match, and the Logos/Icons family alias.
